title: Selective Functionalization of 1-substituted-3-arylquinoxalin-2(1H)-ones via C–H activation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17005-17020
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00901H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Prashant Kumar, Priya, Sriparna Dutta, Deepak Mishra, Naresh Kumar
This review provides an overview of the Pd-, Ru- and Rh-catalyzed regioselective functionalization of the ortho-C(sp2)–H bond of the 3-phenyl ring of N-alkyl-3 phenylquinoxalin-2(1H)-ones.
